decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2835 - 02/FP Rev A, dated 20/11; 2835 - 03/FP Rev A, dated 20/11; received 20/11/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The level of noise emitted from the air conditioning units shown on the approved drawings  shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any 24 hour period in accordance with the guidance set out by BS4142.1997.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the shop
